purpose: one-track offline line-improvement demonstration after two-track PP/LQR/MPC feasibility; no within-lap adaptation
line_objective: minimize sum ||p-p0||^2 + weight*sum ||p[i-1]-2p[i]+p[i+1]||^2 on periodic vertices; this is quadratic smoothness, not exact minimum curvature
geometry_gate: each candidate must pass closure, ordering, intersection, true curvature, expanded vehicle-footprint map clearance and target speed-profile limits from the frozen line rules
candidate_budget: three candidate lines including unchanged baseline; three controller settings per line, identical setting ranges and one tuning run per setting

controller_settings.selection: completion without collision, then minimum independent RMS reference distance; every candidate retained
controller_settings.freeze: commit chosen parameters and line hashes before evaluation

model: same nominal per-track LQR/MPC linear model in expansion_protocol.json for every line candidate
source_reuse: weight 0 line equals reference_constrained.csv byte-for-byte; previously registered nine MapZoo Berlin tuning runs may be reused only if their line hash, seed, world start and controller parameters match this protocol
selection: for each line choose each controller setting by complete noncolliding minimum independent RMS reference distance on fixed tuning pose; line eligible only if all three selected runs complete without collision; among eligible lines choose lowest mean Gym finish time on tuning pose, all candidates retained
final_freeze: commit selected line SHA and three controller configurations before one zero-offset evaluation run per controller
evaluation: compare each frozen final-line controller to the previous frozen MapZoo Berlin zero-offset evaluation on the source constrained line; report signed Gym finish difference, completion, tracking and footprint/compute limits; no best-lap selection
latency: ideal simulator time; measured controller wall-clock duration and missed 10 ms deadlines reported separately
noncompletion: null lap time for selection, preserve status and telemetry; no finite collision penalty
scope: simulation development only; no physical validation, paper abstention threshold, reserved outcomes or real-data campaign
numeric_tolerance_basis: Nine-decimal CSV export moves squared-speed acceleration boundary by about 3.1e-8 m/s^2; 1e-7 only covers numeric serialization, while source-line violations exceed limits by whole m/s^2.
fixed_pose_basis: Exact initial_pose() projection onto the first source-line segment, matching the already registered MapZoo Berlin tuning runs; the earlier central-heading estimate differed by 0.001394 m.
